text: It should be noted that the ceiling effect is an abstract concept. Although a theoretical hypertrophic ceiling does exist, people never actually realize their full genetic potential. The ability to further increase muscle mass is always present. Indeed, muscular gains can be made even at very advanced levels, albeit at a much slower pace than during the initial stages of training. Numerous research studies show that those with considerable training experience do build appreciable muscle when a novel stimulus is applied (3, 73, 74).
